subject: Kestrel security intake — SOC 2 artifacts, bridge letter & portal provisioning
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: James Walker <j.walker@kestrelhealth.com>, Anika Singh <anika.singh@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Kestrel security intake — SOC 2 artifacts, bridge letter & portal provisioning

Hi James / Anika —

Thanks again for taking the time on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have the same plan: 

1) Artifacts we typically deliver for procurement: latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PDF), bridge letter if the Type II window doesn't fully cover your procurement period, and our standard data processing addendum (DPA).

2) Portal access: we can provision a Trust Portal workspace for Kestrel Health so your auditors can pull docs directly. To invite the right people, please confirm the emails you want added and whether you prefer SSO (SAML) or invite-by-email.

3) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): I attached a fillable first-pass Excel (Initial_VSQ_fillable.xlsx) — if you prefer, we can have our compliance team fill most answers and mark items where we need clarifications from you.

4) Timeline: if you can return the VSQ and confirm invitees by EOD Wednesday (11/17), we can provision portal access and upload the SOC 2 + bridge letter draft by Friday (11/19).

Attachments: Initial_VSQ_fillable.xlsx (fillable VSQ)

Open items for you: confirm portal invite list, indicate SSO vs email invite, and flag any procurement deadlines.

I’ve looped in Evelyn (security) and Rachel (contracts) for any technical or DPA questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: James Walker <j.walker@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anika Singh <anika.singh@kestrelhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 15:18:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Kestrel security intake — SOC 2 artifacts, bridge letter & portal provisioning

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- We absolutely need the scoped SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine). What is the exact coverage window for your most recent Type II? Our audit window starts 12/01 so we need to confirm overlap.
- For the bridge letter: will that be a one-page statement confirming control continuity between reports? We may need legal to review a draft.
- VSQ: we will start filling the sheet you sent. I’m attaching our first-pass with some extra columns (Kestrel_VSQ_v1_2027.xlsx).

Also, regarding data residency and PII: can you confirm whether any unredacted customer PII is retained by Redwood in logs? We may need a short note for our security team.

If possible, invite these two people to the portal: procurement@kestrelhealth.com and anita.lee@kestrelhealth.com. We prefer the invite-by-email flow for now.

—James
Director of Procurement
Kestrel Health

Attachment: Kestrel_VSQ_v1_2027.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: James Walker <j.walker@kestrelhealth.com>, Anika Singh <anika.singh@kestrelhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:22:44 -0800
Subject: Re: Kestrel security intake — SOC 2 artifacts, bridge letter & portal provisioning

Hi James / Anika —

Thanks for the VSQ — we’ll take a pass and mark which items require more context. To answer your questions quickly: 

- Coverage window: our most recent SOC 2 Type II report covers 2027-01-01 through 2027-06-30 (report issued 2027-08-05). If you need confirmation for a later window, we can provide a bridge letter that states control continuity through the procurement date.

- Bridge letter: yes, it’s a short attestation (1 page) signed by our security lead confirming there have been no material control changes since the report period. I’m attaching a draft (redwood_bridge_letter_draft_20271115.pdf) for legal review — please treat as draft and share any language requests.

- PII/logging: Redwood does not retain unredacted end-user PII in persistent logs. We store operational telemetry and aggregated metrics; where customer data is logged for troubleshooting it is redacted or obfuscated per our retention policy (30 days for raw traces, 365 days for aggregated metrics). We can provide a short technical note for your security team and a pointer to our Data Processing Addendum.

Portal provisioning: I created a provisional workspace and can invite procurement@kestrelhealth.com and anita.lee@kestrelhealth.com once you confirm Anika’s SAML contact if you change to SSO. Invite link: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/kestrel-health-invite

Next steps from us: 
- We’ll upload the redacted SOC 2 and bridge letter draft to the portal by Friday.
- Rachel will follow up with the DPA and procurement-ready contract language.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_bridge_letter_draft_20271115.pdf (application/pdf)
From: James Walker <j.walker@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Anika Singh <anika.singh@kestrelhealth.com>, procurement@kestrelhealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:47:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Kestrel security intake — SOC 2 artifacts, bridge letter & portal provisioning

Evelyn / Vanessa —

Got the draft bridge letter and SOC 2 confirmation. Portal invites went through for procurement@kestrelhealth.com and anita.lee@kestrelhealth.com — thank you. I asked our legal to review the bridge letter and they’ll send back any redlines by Friday.

Procurement request: can you also share a DocuSign link for the standard SAAS agreement + DPA so we can start countersigning? That will speed our internal approval. Also propose a 30-minute follow-up on Monday 11/22 at 10am PT to review outstanding items and timeline — is that available on your side?

Thanks,
James
